description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice Calling for Claims to Property of Intestate D/S Division, Homagama
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically deals with land title registration for intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It calls for claims to property of a deceased person, provides detailed land information (village, divisional secretary's division, cadastral map number, parcel number, extent of land), and involves the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content is primarily focused on land ownership and title registration matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
